lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are distributed in an irregular grid. Key nodes posterior to the branchial region form a triangular arrangement with inter-blob spacing of approximately 50-70 pixels in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a rectilinear pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature running horizontally along the upper flank displays a sharp vertical gradient, with a high-luminance upper edge transitioning to a deep shadow below, extending from the post-cranial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-pink area of pigmentation loss or surface trauma is visible on the dorsal surface of the head, posterior to the rostrum.
other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and anterior head region exhibit a significantly higher density of micro-blobs (diameter < 5 pixels) compared to the larger maculations on the lateral flank.
